data.body: Durable-record checkpoint at origin/main 4d6c1cc835e0. ADRs 0042 and 0090 intentionally retain accepted historical status while prominent banners identify ADR 0047 as their superseding decision. No status correction is proposed. ADR 0071 already identifies itself as a proposed design spike with deferred implementation, and its source ticket delivered design rather than implementation. No correction is proposed. The stale autodeploy citation at infra/runbooks/review-bot-ops.md line 190 belongs in the ADR renumbering correction. CHANGELOG.md follows a generate-then-curate ownership model documented by the Makefile and docs/releasing.md, so incorrect ADR references may be corrected in place without changing release substance.
